mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities and nephrotoxicity, while meclizine has anticholinergic properties and CNS effects that may be potentiated in patients with renal impairment or electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, phosphate), and CNS symptoms; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy; use meclizine cautiously and consider alternative antiemetics if significant renal dysfunction develops.
